theorem E3_v2 :
    (∀ l : List (Fin 4), ∀ q ∉ L,
      Summable (fun a : L => ‖iteratedPartial l
          (zetaJet [] (a : ℍ)) q‖)) ∧
    (∀ l : List (Fin 4), ∀ K : Set ℍ, IsCompact K → K ⊆
        (L : Set ℍ)ᶜ →
      TendstoUniformlyOn (fun s : Finset L => fun q =>
        ∑ a ∈ s, iteratedPartial l (zetaJet [] (a : ℍ))
            q)
        (iteratedPartial l (zeta L)) atTop K) ∧
    (∀ l : List (Fin 4), HasSumLocallyUniformlyOn
      (fun a : L => iteratedPartial l (zetaJet [] (a :
          ℍ)))
      (iteratedPartial l (zeta L)) (L : Set ℍ)ᶜ) ∧
    Function.Odd (zeta L) ∧
    TwoSidedRegularOn (zeta L) (L : Set ℍ)ᶜ ∧
    (∀ j : Fin 3, ∀ q ∉ L, coordPartial j.succ (zeta L)
        q = elliptic L j q) ∧
    (∃! η : L →+ ℍ, ∀ w : L, ∀ q : ℍ, q ∉ L →
      zeta L (q + (w : ℍ)) - zeta L q = η w)

def zetaJet (l : List (Fin 4)) (a q : ℍ) : ℍ := by
  classical
  exact iteratedPartial l kernel (q + a) - if a = 0
      then 0 else
    match l with
    | [] => kernel a + fderiv ℝ kernel a q
    | [μ] => coordPartial μ kernel a
    | _ :: _ :: _ => 0

declarations.name: MathResearch.Fueter.zetaQuasiperiod
declarations.display_text:
def zetaQuasiperiod : L →+ ℍ where
  toFun w := zeta L (zetaBasepoint L + (w : ℍ)) - zeta
      L (zetaBasepoint L)
  map_zero' := by simp
  map_add' v w := by
    have h := zeta_increment_const L w
        (not_mem_lattice_add L v (zetaBasepoint_not_mem
        L))
      (zetaBasepoint_not_mem L)
    change zeta L (zetaBasepoint L + ((v : ℍ) + (w :
        ℍ))) - zeta L (zetaBasepoint L) = _
    rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add] at h
    rw [← add_assoc, h]
    abel
